svg.title: Logical Class Diagram
svg.desc: Documentation-ready class diagram derived from current backend modules.
svg.text: Service-layer view of the Express / Prisma backend
JavaScript modules export functions; they are shown as UML logical classes for documentation.
Prisma data access and session persistence
Prisma queries for assignments, plans and meals
Direct PrismaClient usage in commerce services
Dependency arrows show runtime calls. Controllers and repositories remain feature-scoped; only logical groupings are condensed here.
